nodes.title: SG-1.2 · Create the Zustand UI store for drawer, modal, sound and settings
nodes.body:
Context: game/frontend has no Zustand dependency and no store. GameLayout keeps drawerOpen in local useState. Desired behavior: a single importable store holds drawer, modal, sound and settings flags with actions such as toggleDrawer. Expected result: components can import useUiStore from game/frontend/src/store/uiStore.ts. Why: the shell needs shared UI state without prop drilling.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the frontend module, When a component imports useUiStore from src/store/uiStore, Then it resolves and type-checks
- Given the store, When toggleDrawer is called, Then drawerOpen flips between false and true


## Scope
- In scope: zustand dependency
- In scope: src/store/uiStore.ts
- Out of scope: Rewiring GameLayout or HeaderOverlay to the store
- Out of scope: Phaser integration
- Preserve: Existing GameLayout behavior
- Preserve: Existing tests


## Technical constraints
- Zustand is the mandated state library
- Store lives in game/frontend/src


## Definition of done
- Store file exists and is importable
- Store unit tests pass


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Zustand dependency and drawer and modal state with actions
nodes.body:
Context: no store exists. Desired behavior: useUiStore holds drawerOpen (default false) and activeModal (null | 'contribution' | 'settings') with toggleDrawer, setDrawerOpen, openModal and closeModal. Expected result: importable store. Why: drawer and contribution modal need shared state.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a fresh store, When read, Then drawerOpen is false and activeModal is null
- Given a fresh store, When toggleDrawer is called twice, Then drawerOpen is true then false
- Given a fresh store, When openModal('contribution') then closeModal() are called, Then activeModal is 'contribution' then null


## Scope
- In scope: package.json zustand dependency
- In scope: drawer and modal state/actions
- Out of scope: sound and settings flags
- Out of scope: component rewiring
- Preserve: Existing dependencies


## Technical constraints
- Use zustand create with typed state interface


## Definition of done
- Drawer and modal actions implemented


## Clarifying questions
- None

steps.action: Add to interface UiState: soundEnabled: boolean; settingsOpen: boolean; toggleSound: () => void; setSoundEnabled: (on: boolean) => void; toggleSettings: () => void.
In the create initializer add soundEnabled: true, settingsOpen: false and the three actions.

soundEnabled: true,
settingsOpen: false,
toggleSound: () => set((s) => ({ soundEnabled: !s.soundEnabled })),
setSoundEnabled: (on) => set({ soundEnabled: on }),
toggleSettings: () => set((s) => ({ settingsOpen: !s.settingsOpen })),
